headline: 2027 meetings set for April 7th and November 3rd, both first Wednesdays of the month
summary: Minutes from September 2nd and September 30th were approved. Two 2027 meeting dates were also set, since at least two meetings are required each year. A clerk's office opinion about a member being asked to step aside came up in discussion.
decisions: Approved April 7th and November 3rd as the 2027 meeting dates.
discussion: 2027 meeting dates: Members discussed April and November options before settling on April 7th and November 3rd, the first Wednesday of each month.
Recusal opinion: A written opinion from the clerk's office explains why a member was asked to recuse herself.

decision_evidence.quote: So we need a motion to accept those as our new dates for 2027. Motion to accept the 2027 dates. ... All in favor? Aye.
